examples.title: Extract a single page (first page only)

description: Plain-text extraction: decodes Tj/TJ operands through each font's /ToUnicode CMap, /Encoding /Differences or base encoding and returns pages[] + fullText (positioned runs with includeRuns:true; `pages` selects 0-based pages). `extractable` is false only when a page decoded ENTIRELY to U+FFFD (a font with no usable mapping — expected for some subset fonts, not an error; extractableReason explains). Tagged content carrying /ActualText (every pdfA document this server writes) returns that SOURCE text, in logical order; untagged right-to-left and Indic runs come back in the order their glyphs were drawn — generate with pdfA when faithful extraction of complex scripts matters. Encrypted sources: pass `password` (PASSWORD_REQUIRED / PASSWORD_INVALID otherwise). Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary', fields:[…].

fields.description: Optional dot-path projection applied to the structured result (e.g. ['fullText'] or ['extractable']). Composes after verbosity. Unknown paths are omitted.

includeRuns.description: When true, each page also carries `runs[]` — positioned text-showing operations `{ text, x, y, fontSize, fontName }` in device space (content-stream order). Useful for layout-aware extraction; larger responses.

maxTextLength.description: Hard cap on total extracted characters across all pages (memory bound for adversarial input). Default 16000000. Exceeding it fails with OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE.

pages.description: Optional 0-based page indices to extract. When omitted, every page is extracted.

password.description: Password (user or owner) of an encrypted source. Never logged or echoed.

verbosity.description: Response verbosity. 'full' (default) returns the per-page pages[] array and fullText; 'summary' returns a token-frugal { pageCount, extractedPageCount, extractable, charCount } and drops the text payloads.

name: extract_text

outputSchema.description: Structured text-extraction result. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

extractable.description: False when one or more requested pages produced text that is entirely U+FFFD replacement characters — a font with no usable /ToUnicode CMap or base encoding. Blank pages are still considered extractable.

extractableReason.description: Present when extractable is false: why no text could be decoded.

runs.description: Positioned text runs (present only when includeRuns is true).

title: Extract plain text from PDF
